items.overview: A powerful drug cartel pulls the strings behind a facade of sun-soaked beaches as a gritty, violent underworld power struggle emerges during the crumbling of Portuguese colonial rule.

items.overview: Inspector Vikram is the typical do-gooder cop, who also entertains and ensures no crime is left unsolved. What happens when he gets to meet a villain who is smarter than the average criminal and heads a drug racket?

items.title: Tenali Rama
items.overview: Tenali Rama is the comedy film with funny dialogs.Ramesh Arvind is a B.Com graduate and Jaggesh is an S.S.L.C holder and both of them are searching the job but a fake employment agent tells them that he will take them to Dubai.

items.title: Gili Bete
items.overview: Gili Bete (ಗಿಳಿ ಬೇಟೆ) is a 1992 Kannada film directed by Vemagal Jagannath Rao, starring Vinod Raj and Taara, featuring a supporting cast including Nagesh Mayya, Ramesh Bhat, and Shivaram, known for its music and general 90s Kannada cinema vibe.

items.title: Amara Jyothi
items.overview: The film is a family drama about a man whose past love causes problems in his current relationship and leads to misunderstandings.

items.title: Ananthu v/s Nusrath
items.overview: Ananthu is advocate belonging to an orthodox Brahmin family, who falls in Love with Nusrath Fathima baig, a Muslim girl. How Ananthu wins his love is the plot. Whole love story revolves in Court and Narrated in a humorous way.

items.title: K.G.F: Chapter 1
items.overview: A period drama set in the 1970s, KGF follows the story of a fierce rebel who rises against the brutal oppression in Kolar Gold Fields and becomes the symbol of hope to legions of downtrodden people.
